arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Fisher argued against retaining the reliability prong of the Roberts framework.
Mr. Dreeben stated the clause should limit testimonial statements but not bar them absolutely.
Mr. Sherman asked the Court to retain the reliability framework of Ohio v. Roberts.
